Photo estimate

Photo ruler uses a pixel-length ratio. It works only when both lengths are on the same plane, photographed straight on. It does not recover hidden depth or correct perspective. Use a side photo for depth.

Checks a rectangular footprint only. Extra clearance is your chosen allowance, not a sensor accuracy estimate. Doors, access, furniture movement, and height need separate checks.
